notes:
Original-source rule applied: no original statistics taken from the replication paper. Original publisher PDF access returned 403; DOI landing page provided only abstract; OpenAlex had no OA full-text location; promising mirrored PDF failed TLS validation and returned 404 on final retrieval. Replication title verified against supplied reference. Cached institutional preprint plus published primary-PDF excerpts used. Main-effect Hedges’s g retained as printed. No main-effect z/t statistic or p was established: printed Q p values test heterogeneity, and printed z/p pairs test small-telescopes or equivalence hypotheses, so these were not combined with the main-effect g. Supplied replication page does not resolve test ambiguity; target_match left null. Narrative verdict is authors’ overall conclusion, not an inference from significance.
Source follow-up: Published final article copy with publisher-history cover; OnlineFirst history is not the artifact version. Numeric contrast checked on rendered PDF p. 4. The analytic model uses all 54 participants and pooled residual df=51; the two compared groups are identified separately, without treating their sum as the model N.
